words.gram: nominative neuter singular, used as a noun

lines.trans: A bribe-taker!
First of all, there hasn't been a trial yet.
And second?
And second, I can buy you a toy, and your mum can't.
Why?
Because she's naive. Everybody cheats her.
My mum is good!
She is good, nobody's saying she isn't. Hey, what's wrong?
Lyosha, what happened? Breathe, son, breathe!

words.gram: masculine singular, nominative, used as address

lines.trans: We were only eating caviar!
The child told you he has an allergy.

words.gram: genitive, н- form after a preposition

lines.trans: I thought you were lying to him because caviar is expensive.

words.gram: present, 2nd person plural (polite), imperfective; kept in the present after 'thought'

lines.trans: I never lie to my child.
Mum, I gave him my piggy bank for a games console.
What's the problem? I'll buy him the console.
We don't need your console! Come near my child again and you'll be sorry!
I'm leaving. Your son will be poor and honest.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
Present есть; у меня есть = I have.

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?
Arkady Borisovich, who are your rivals?

examples.text: Вы взяточник! Вы лезете вперёд больного ребёнка.
examples.trans: You're a bribe-taker! You're pushing in ahead of a sick child.

meanings.note: A side word, set off by commas.

examples.text: А во-вторых, у меня нет денег.
examples.trans: And secondly, I have no money.

meanings.note: A side word, set off by commas.

examples.trans: First of all, there hasn't been a trial yet.

examples.text: Не надо врать. Стену монастыря сносят!
examples.trans: Don't lie. They're pulling down the monastery wall!

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

meanings.note: Я тебе говорю = I'm telling you.
Много дел = a lot to do.

examples.trans: I have a lot to do.

examples.text: Мне некогда об этом думать. Слишком много дел.
examples.trans: I have no time to think about that. There's too much to do.

держаться.gloss: to hold on; to stick with

meanings.note: за + accusative: держись за руку = hold on to my hand

meanings.en: to stick with, keep close to
meanings.note: + genitive: держитесь меня = stick with me

examples.text: Держитесь меня, и всё будет хорошо.
examples.trans: Stick with me and everything will be fine.

examples.text: Держитесь меня, и всё у вас будет хорошо. Потому что я кто?
examples.trans: Stick with me, and everything will be fine for you. Because who am I?

meanings.note: to a loved one, and at the start of letters

examples.text: В Москве вам дают деньги на дорогую одежду, а мозги не дают.
examples.trans: In Moscow they give you money for expensive clothes, but they don't give you brains.

meanings.note: думать о + prepositional = to think about

examples.trans: I have no time to think about that.

examples.text: Мне некогда об этом думать. Слишком много дел.
examples.trans: I have no time to think about that. There's too much to do.

examples.text: Лёша, что случилось? Дыши, сынок, дыши!
examples.trans: Lyosha, what happened? Breathe, son, breathe!

meanings.note: not to be confused with есть 'there is' (from быть)

examples.text: Я вчера ел маринованные грибы. Может, один гриб был плохой.
examples.trans: Yesterday I ate pickled mushrooms. Maybe one mushroom was bad.

meanings.note: in threats: ты ещё увидишь = you'll see

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.
Mum bought her son a toy.

examples.text: А во-вторых, я тебе могу игрушку купить, а твоя мама нет.
examples.trans: And second, I can buy you a toy, and your mum can't.

meanings.note: красная икра = red (salmon) caviar, чёрная икра = black caviar

examples.text: Мама говорила, что у меня на икру аллергия.
examples.trans: Mum said I'm allergic to caviar.
There's someone here to see you.

examples.text: Аркадий Борисович, извините, тут к вам человек.
examples.trans: Arkady Borisovich, I'm sorry, there's a man here to see you.
Have you got a piggy bank?
The money is in the piggy bank.

examples.text: А у кого есть? Так, Шнурок, есть же копилка?
examples.trans: So who has? Right, Shoelace, you've got a piggy bank, haven't you?
Arkady Borisovich, who are your rivals?

examples.text: Юле бы дублёнку купили, Славику бы ноутбук.
examples.trans: We could have bought Yulia a sheepskin coat, and Slavik a laptop.

examples.text: Этого не может быть. Это наша история.
examples.trans: That can't be. It's our history.

meanings.note: нас = us (gen/acc/prep); у нас = we have, at our place

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
+ genitive: 'у нас нет выбора' = we have no choice
used with не before the verb, or alone

examples.text: Я никогда не был на море.
examples.trans: I've never been to the sea.

examples.text: Никто не будет командовать на моей кухне!
examples.trans: Nobody is going to give orders in my kitchen!

examples.text: Не говори об этом никому, ладно?
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone about this, okay?
But legally you are nobody to her.

meanings.note: short form 'нужен / нужна / нужно / нужны' + dative: 'мне нужна работа' = I need a job

examples.text: Потому что она простая. Её все обманывают.
examples.trans: Because she's naive. Everybody cheats her.

meanings.note: accusative/genitive его (него after prepositions), dative ему (нему)

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

examples.text: Она нашла нас на новом месте.
examples.trans: She found us at the new place.
That is it, she got really offended.
She is not answering her phone.

meanings.en: to give away, to hand over

examples.trans: He will hand over the money.

examples.text: Потом надо отдать москвичам твои деньги из подвала.
examples.trans: Then I have to give your money from the basement to the Moscow people.

meanings.en: to come up to, to approach

examples.text: Нам не нужна ваша приставка! Ещё раз подойдёте к моему ребёнку — пожалеете!
examples.trans: We don't need your console! Come near my child again and you'll be sorry!

meanings.note: ты ещё пожалеешь! = you'll be sorry!

examples.text: Ты знаешь, сколько у меня денег? Ты ещё пожалеешь!
examples.trans: Do you know how much money I have? You'll be sorry!

examples.text: Я устал, потому что много работал.
examples.trans: I'm tired because I worked a lot.
I'm at home because I'm ill.
Why are we going so slowly?

examples.text: Виталик, почему мы так медленно едем? Быстрее!
examples.trans: Vitalik, why are we going so slowly? Faster!
We're saving up for a games console.
How much does the console cost?

examples.text: Мы с мамой на приставку копим.
examples.trans: Mum and I are saving up for a games console.
I know the problems of ordinary people.

meanings.note: refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word

examples.text: А что я за мэр такой, который держит своё слово?
examples.trans: And what kind of mayor would I be if I kept my word?

meanings.note: once; что скажешь? = what do you say?

examples.trans: Tell us, when will your programme be out?

examples.text: Марина, я вам обещаю: со стеной ничего не случится.
examples.trans: Marina, I promise you: nothing will happen to the wall.

examples.text: Суд решил: домашний арест по месту прописки.
examples.trans: The court has decided: house arrest at his registered address.

examples.text: Я этого не хочу. Но вспомни, у тебя сын болеет.
examples.trans: I don't want that. But remember, your son is ill.

meanings.note: affectionate form of сын, often used as a form of address

examples.text: Лёша, что случилось? Дыши, сынок, дыши!
examples.trans: Lyosha, what happened? Breathe, son, breathe!

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

meanings.note: softens a request: только не сердись = just don't be angry

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.en: to leave, to go away (on foot)

examples.text: Какое хорошее утро! Лидия Алексеевна, чашку кофе, пожалуйста.
examples.trans: What a lovely morning! Lidia Alekseyevna, a cup of coffee, please.

examples.text: Я ухожу. Ваш сын будет бедным и честным.
examples.trans: I'm leaving. Your son will be poor and honest.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.
Хорошая, никто же не говорит. Эй, ты что?
examples.trans: She is good, nobody's saying she isn't. Hey, what's wrong?
